form.name: Certification of Driving Experience of a Minor

title: CERTIFICATION OF DRIVING EXPERIENCE OF A MINOR

certification.text: I do hereby certify that {student_name}, a minor, date of birth {birthday}, has driven a minimum of 50 hours during the past 12 months, of which 10 hours of driving were at night per Section 322.05(3), Florida Statutes.

signatures.label: Signature of Parent, Legal Guardian or Responsible Adult

notary.title: STATE OF FLORIDA
notary.text: COUNTY OF ______ Sworn to (or affirmed) and subscribed before me this ____day of ______, 20____, by ______ who is personally known to me or produced identification. ______ as proof of identification. (Identification type and number)
lines: Print, Type, or Stamp Commissioned Name of Notary Public

certification.extra_text: INSTRUCTIONS: 1. One parent, legal guardian, or other responsible adult 21 years old or older must sign this form. 2. All signatures must be notarized or witnessed by an examiner.

notes: The name blank is printed as 'First Middle Last'; LicenseLogger writes the name on file.
